versions.changelog:
Initial release of douyin-realtime-hot-rises:

- Provides real-time trending topic analysis and content ideation tools for Douyin creators, marketers, and analysts.
- Supports four main features: keyword-based video/article search, real-time hotlist lookup, public post harvesting by creator, and video/comment analysis.
- Offers secure, no-login data access with support for high-volume results and robust filtering/sorting options.
- Returns structured, detailed JSON data for further reporting, comparison, and advanced analysis.
- Usage requires a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN; works via Node.js command-line interfaces with clear execution and error handling guidelines.
